title: Implement GC scheduler and unpin executor
description:
Implement a periodic GC task (configurable interval, default 24h) that: (1) queries the article store for all CIDs not covered by the pinning policy, (2) calls unpin() for each, (3) logs each unpinned CID with its reason, (4) increments gc_articles_unpinned_total metric. Artifact: transit/src/retention/gc.rs.

Acceptance:
- GC runs on configured schedule (tokio interval, not cron)
- Pinned articles are never passed to unpin()
- GC run duration is logged and exposed as a metric
- Unit test: insert 5 articles, pin 2, run GC, verify only 3 are unpinned
